# Fabricated author names in the open-recall answers: neighbour confusion (bottleneck C)

**Exploratory (探索性), post hoc. Not preregistered.** Generated by `~/jlens_work/14_groups/fabricated_names_20261114.py`.

## Data

- Answers: ORIGINAL label package open answers (`/scratch/zhang.zhiqi2/jlens/labels_20261015/zhiqi_qwen3-32b_labels_2026-10-15/open_results.jsonl`, greedy, run 2026-10-15_qwen3-32b_v3-measure-a100), not the 2-11b regenerations.
- Matcher: Stage 10 R0/R1 reconstruction (surname + first initial, either order, one-to-one), verbatim; per-author hits equal `391_groups/data/author_flags.parquet` (0 mismatches). Papers whose rebuilt count != label m: 18 (kept).
- Fabricated name occurrences: 45663; unique within paper: 40598. Pre-classes (excluded from shares): single_token 312, repeat_true 67 (si keys).
- Target = group_tight target = A + C (R0/R1 with tight strong team MC); control = B + D (R0/R1, tight fail). Same as Stage 10 / Addendum 7.
- CI: author-team cluster bootstrap, 2000 draws over 7247 teams (folds_own9108_k5s13.npz), pooled ratio. Chance baselines: 20 draws each.

## Caveats

- Exploratory, post hoc. Name keys are coarse: surname + first initial collides for common surnames (Wang Y, Smith J), so coauthor / in-dataset matches include homonyms (e.g. "Xiao-Yan Liu" -> liu x links any paper with a Liu X.; common Chinese and Korean surnames dominate the coauthor class). The random-author baselines do not carry this paper-specific collision; the permuted-fabricated baselines carry the name popularity but not the pairing of a paper with same-origin common names; the rare-key sensitivity (si_rare) removes common keys. Full-name exact keys under-match because many cohort names are initials only (Semantic Scholar "S. Bree").
- The coauthor network is built from the 9,108-paper cohort only (shared author key on another cohort paper), not from the outside literature: "not_in_data" includes real people outside the cohort.
- Pooled ratio over names: papers with many fabricated names (cut-off loops) weigh more; paper-mean shares are in the csv (`paper_mean`).
- Single-token names and names repeating a true author are excluded from shares (counts above).
